geometry.radiusConvention: The published numerical support endpoints are interpreted as exact IEEE754 dyadic rationals; every support remains strictly within its source patch.

normalization.base: E0=K*x^alpha, U0=c; K>0 and c are parameters constant in x on the patch
normalization.parameterIndependence: Every map coefficient below is independent of K, c, eta and Pstar. K(eta)>0 and c(eta) may vary smoothly.
normalization.wholeEtaStatement: For every eta in [-1,1] and every smooth K(eta)>0,c(eta), the same neighbourhood applies whenever the same normalized debt bounds hold.

quadrature.method: Positive Riemann-Stieltjes enclosures: sum range(weight,cell)*(sigma(right)-sigma(left)); squares use sigma_prime(cell)*d_sigma.

sourceDebtMembershipDiagnostics.interpretation: Existing measured Float64 debts interpreted as exact dyadic numbers for membership only; no quadrature-error enclosure is attached to those upstream debts.
